verification.qualification: Optional manual conditions and their induced states; contextual Speed and Exhaustion penalty displayed without rewriting base sheet statistics. Physical death-save dice and other modifiers are entered explicitly; natural 1/20, stabilization, remaining Prone, confirmed death/revival and Exhaustion 6 are covered. Damage at zero HP uses a player-declared failure count; instant death, special survival abilities, effect durations and other contextual combat effects remain table decisions. Long rests reduce tracked Exhaustion by one, as do short rests for Ranger level 10+. Old clients preserve optional fields and cannot silently heal a declared dead character. No catalogue revision, automatic rolls or existing-character migration.
